shape.description: box: carton; bottle: narrow neck and cap; can; jar: wide lid; tub: wider at the top, with a lid; pouch: pillow-shaped bag sealed at both ends; jug: 5 l oil jug (rounded square body, spout moved to the front, a handle at the back); produce without a label (round: tomato, orange; onion; garlic; nut: walnut; tuber: potato; leaf: a fallen leaf lying flat, width × curl height × length); ware for cooked food: bowl (foot ring, wall thickness), plate (shallow rounded square)

size.description: width (diameter for bottles, cans, jars, tubs and bowls), height, depth (cartons, pouches and plates; produce: elongated when given); unit: m

font.description: font of the label text (Shared/Fonts/ZCOOLQingKeHuangYou from @stride-ts/assets has Chinese); no text without one; content path of a font asset (no extension)

brand.description: brand name in big letters; two or three common characters picked from the seed when missing

text.description: product kind under the brand (e.g. 生抽, 矿泉水); none when missing

background.description: label background (sRGB #rrggbb; picked from the seed when missing)

accent.description: pattern color (sRGB #rrggbb; picked from the seed when missing)

text.description: text color (black or white by contrast when missing) (sRGB #rrggbb; picked from the seed when missing)

cap.description: cap or lid color (sRGB #rrggbb; picked from the seed when missing)

trim.description: trim lines and emblem color (gold, white or off-white) (sRGB #rrggbb; picked from the seed when missing)

colors.description: label colors; the missing ones come from the seed, so variants of one file differ in them

pattern.description: label pattern (floral: blue-and-white porcelain bands for ware); picked from the seed when missing, ware: bowls floral, plates plain

surface.description: material (roughness, metalness); by shape when missing: cartons paper, cans metal, jars glass, produce skin, ware ceramic, others plastic

accent.description: side ingredient color (red pepper, scallion; sRGB #rrggbb); a darker main color when missing

sauce.description: sauce under the food (sRGB #rrggbb); the main color darkened when missing

level.description: how high the food reaches the wall (0..1 of the inner depth)

mound.description: how much the middle heaps up (fraction of the ware height)

pieces.description: what the food looks like: chunks (braised pork, fried chicken), strands (shredded potato, bean sprouts), beans (peanuts, soybeans), smooth (mashed, custard)

dropped.description: how many real pieces (by pieces: chunks, strands, beans; not smooth) are dropped on top and settled with physics when baking; 0 draws the food only on the surface texture

pieceSize.description: size of one dropped piece in meters: chunk edge, strand thickness (strands are 10..16 times as long), bean length; 0.02, 0.004, 0.009 when missing

food.description: a dish of food in a bowl or plate; empty ware when missing

motif.description: small picture of the ingredient on both sides of the brand (on a white disc); picked from the seed when missing (leaf, drop, wheat, sunflower or none)

badge.description: text of the starburst in the lower right corner ("5L", "non-GMO"); none when missing

detail.description: print details: emblem, ingredient pictures, fine print, badge, trim lines and shading of the band; false draws only the color blocks, pattern and text (a cartoon look)

wear.description: how handled the package looks (0..1): each variant fades a little and gets a few grimy smudges and scuffs near the edges, from the seed; 0 is fresh from the factory; produce and ware ignore it

transmission.description: how much light passes through the body (0..1: oil and drink bottles show what is inside); the label background is the body, printed parts (cap, pattern, text) stay opaque; produce and ware ignore it

seed.description: random seed of everything not written: another number is another brand of the same product
